transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Okafor, your Signal Officer. Let's get our routine daily communications planning huddle started. We have channels C1 through C4 available for next-day routine coordination, and the signal shop can configure channels and power settings before 1800 today. Before I publish the binding communications configuration, I need to hear current requirements from operations, logistics, maintenance, and airfield representatives. Who would like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a change for the command net. The battalion coordination directive confirmed this morning requires the command net to use C2 from 0600 to 1000 tomorrow. I received the directive after the morning briefing, and the communications slide has not yet been updated to reflect this.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a logistics constraint. I confirmed from the issued-battery ledger that only R3 has enough battery capacity to support the logistics yard tomorrow, and R3 must be configured at low power from 0700 to 1100. The ledger reconciliation is still awaiting posting to the signal work queue, so it hasn't shown up in your shop's tasks yet.
